messages:
Ravi Shah: Quick post-all-hands capture on wins/losses and the feedback loop asks so leadership can respond.

Leah Ortiz: From customer interviews: wins: predictable latency under burst; losses: missing BYO-KMS and lack of per-team billing tags.

Benji Park: Adding a loss datapoint: a large FS customer rejected us because they couldn't get audit exports into their SIEM within procurement timeline.

Natalie Gomez: CS note: several accounts asked for a deployment "smoke test" that customers can run before commit (small, fast on-prem check). They said it lowers legal/procurement friction.

Ravi Shah: Leadership ask: prioritize BYO-KMS + audit export vs. on-prem smoke test. Which is top for Q1?

Leah Ortiz: Pipeline wise, BYO-KMS + audit export closes more deals immediately. Recommend Q1 focus there; smoke test as fast-follow.

Benji Park: Ops: any blockers for audit export?

ops-bot: Summary: INF-612 (audit-streaming reliability), INF-605 (KMS proxy auth). Both need infra time; estimated 4-6 weeks if prioritized.

Natalie Gomez: Sales/CS want a one-page "today vs roadmap" doc to share with prospects while we ship. Can PM/docs deliver by next Wed?

Ravi Shah: Action items: 1) PM draft one-pager by Wed, 2) Infra respond with actionable blocker plan + ETA by Thu, 3) Ops create a minimal on-prem smoke test spec for early Q2.

Leah Ortiz: Also customers ask for better canary examples and a streaming best-practice checklist. Can docs put up a short how-to this sprint?

Benji Park: We can ship a canary example and prefix-caching guide in docs quick. I'll sync with DevEx.

Ravi Shah: Thanks all. Leadership, please confirm priority and whether to reallocate infra headcount for the KMS/audit tickets.

Leah Ortiz: I'll escalate to Execs and report back by Fri.

Natalie Gomez: Posting the anonymized quote: "We chose the vendor that could demonstrably export audit logs to our SIEM."

Ravi Shah: End of thread for now
